content: This case involves a husband seeking the division of a luxury vehicle purchased during a marriage governed by the legal community of property. The wife requested a delay in the division (conguaglio dilazione) under Art. 1111 CC, citing her exclusive use of the car for family needs and her inability to purchase a replacement. The Court addressed the interpretative boundary of judicial delays, establishing that a suspension of division requires an objective interest common to all participants rather than a personal advantage for one spouse. Consequently, the husband’s right to dissolve the community prevailed over the wife’s subjective convenience, and a sale was ordered due to the asset’s indivisibility.
